cuda.title: CUDA acceleration runtime required
cuda.description: The base edition uses lightweight CPU inference. Installation downloads the PyTorch CUDA runtime and restarts the app to enable the GPU.
cuda.space: Keep about 8 GB of free space for the first installation.
cuda.manualStep1: Open either wheel library above and download the two complete .whl files listed above.
cuda.manualStep2: Do not extract them. Put both files directly in the folder below without another nested folder.
cuda.manualStep3: Click “Files are ready, install and enable”. The app removes the two packages after a successful installation.
